rule.gate_rhat_ess_observables: log likelihood, nonconstant log prior, at most two fixed projections: sum(theta)/sqrt(d), alternating-sign sum(theta)/sqrt(d); duplicate projections removed
rule.coordinate_multiplicity: Holm familywise alpha=0.05 across all coordinates, log likelihood, nonconstant log prior and fixed projections, for paired walker mean differences between physical halves
rule.physical_time: split [1024, collector completion) into equal deterministic windows; condition on assigned j=J, include every occupation event; paired t test of walker window means
rule.composite: compression ESS>=20 AND all eight first-K quotas AND all fixed-budget observable Rhat/ESS checks pass AND no Holm physical-window rejection
rule.constant_assigned_top_index: report constant; evaluate assigned-level Rhat/ESS on uncensored physical trace, descriptive only
rule.additional_observables: optional predeclared scalar callbacks, Holm family extended before evaluation; supplement generic gate
rule.threshold_rationale: Stan Rhat<1.01 and approximately 100 bulk/tail effective samples per chain; conventional familywise alpha .05, Holm correction. Projection budget fixed independently of dimension. Paired-t calibration is approximate and requires regular independent walker-level differences.
rule.two_sample_distances: KS and Euclidean energy distance descriptive only: no IID p-values for correlated draws
rule.decision_priority: B if at least half of stationary controls rejected; otherwise C if historical failure passes; otherwise D if dimension interpretation cannot be defended; otherwise E unless A requirements are established

summary.discrimination: No useful historical-vs-stationary discrimination; theta Rhat and bulk ESS trigger all rejections.
